title: Excellent Costa Brava Kayaking with Craig
text: We had such a memorable tour kayaking along the incredible Costa Brava with Craig. He made us feel totally safe and comfortable while he effortlessly guided us on kayaks through the most breathtaking areas of the coast. We ate a delicious lunch on a pristine sandy beach and took swims before heading back. Craig made the day one of our best of a week in Barcelona!
author: Brisees

title: Fantastic Costa Brava Tour with Sara
text:
I went with the Sara guide and it was really spectacular. The views and people very good!!
The blue sea and the perfect day. I'll be back!
author: esmevimar

title: Perfect day!
text: Perfect day on the water.  Seaside atmosphere, several moments of snorkelling, bcp kayaking.  Visit several places where we were alone in the world.  Our guide was very caring with us.  Everything was perfect!
author: caroline g

title: Dahli and Costa Brava
text: We spent the day with Anthony (Antonio) visiting the Dahli and Costa Brava area. He was knowledgeable and personable. We enjoyed a fabulous lunch and conversation! He was punctual. We liked that he gave us time to wander the areas a bit! Fun way to finish our visit to Barcelona! Thank you! ?(our tour was not snorkeling. And included the Dahli)
author: 205adeled

title: Great day Kayak trip
text: We had a great full-day trip from Barcelona with Spanish Trails. Easy pick-up and drop-off. Plenty of time in the kayaks, and also some time to cool off in the water while taking a break from the paddling. Our guide Martin did a great job finding a shaded spot for lunch and with providing a great variety of local foods for our group of four. This was one of the best days of our three-week trip in the western Mediterranean. Highly recommend!
author: Tribe77

title: Ines was an absolute...
text: Ines was an absolute fantastic tour guide. She gave us so much history about Barcelona, Costa Brava and Spain in general!  Costa Brava is spectacular, the wild coast should not be missed on your trip. It wast 12 and 14 year old girls favorite day in our 2 week trip.  Kayaking, cliff jumping and swimming/snorkeling.   The water is much warmer here than down in Costa Del Sol and clear blue/turquoise. It can get pretty windy in the summer but Ines was great and just made sure we were back a bit earlier before the wind really kicked up. Definitely give this trip a go!
author: Kristi_H

title: Sea kayak tour on the Costa Brava from Barcelona
text: Our family recently went on a kayaking excursion with Martin as our guide, and it was an incredible experience. Martin was friendly, knowledgeable, and a lot of fun to be around. He wisely guided us through beautiful spots, such as natural arches, cliff jumping, snorkleing spots, and sharing interesting facts along the way. His infectious sense of fun made the whole experience enjoyable. We highly recommend Martin as a kayak guide.
author: P2574HCjohnk

title: An awesome experience outside Barcelona !
text:
I discovered this experience while searching for things to do around Barcelona, and I am so glad I did ! 

We were a total of 4 couples, coming from different areas of the world, which made the experience quite fun. 

Matteo met us right on time, and drove us from Barcelona to Costs Brava. After a few VERY important safety tips, we were off to paddling our kayaks. Some people had no experience at all, but this didn’t cause any problems or hassle. 

We stopped at a cove, where we were able to experience the beautiful waters. We then had the fun experience of squeezing into a cave with our canoe
author: rawansaab

title: 10/10! Fun in the sun
text: WE ABSOLUTELY LOVED IT! Craig was amazing, he’s not only such a talented tour guide, but he is extremely knowledgeable!
author: alonnndramtz

title: Fun Family Day!
text:
We added this kayak day at the last minute, and were so glad we did. 

Our guide, Martin, was perfection.

We kayaked, jumped off a big rock, snorkeled, picnicked and enjoyed a really great family day. 

Pro Tip: Wear water shoes. Really. Wear water shoes.
author: mjp19751
